Description: Customer enters valid username and password and logs in to the banking portal.
Preconditions: Customer account exists and is active; internet banking is enabled
Expected Result: User is redirected to dashboard and authentication succeeds

Description: Customer enters wrong username or password.
Expected Result: System shows login failure with generic message; no account data exposed

Description: Customer enters wrong password repeatedly.
Preconditions: Customer has not reached maximum invalid login attempts
Expected Result: Account is locked and customer is prompted to reset password or contact support

Description: User remains idle beyond configured timeout.
Expected Result: Session expires and user is logged out automatically

Description: User navigates to account overview page.
Preconditions: Customer has one or more active accounts
Expected Result: All eligible accounts and balances are displayed accurately

Description: User views list of transactions for a selected account.
Expected Result: Transactions are listed in correct date order with status and amount

Description: User transfers money from one account to another within same bank.
Expected Result: Transfer succeeds and both accounts reflect correct balances

Description: User tries to transfer amount above available balance.
Expected Result: Transfer is declined and no balance change occurs

Description: User transfers to an external beneficiary.
Preconditions: Beneficiary has been added and validated
Expected Result: Transfer is processed, reference ID generated, and confirmation is displayed

Description: User resubmits same transaction.
Expected Result: Only one transaction is processed and duplicate is blocked

Description: User adds a new beneficiary with valid details.
Expected Result: Beneficiary is successfully saved and verification is completed

Description: User enters invalid or blank beneficiary data.
Preconditions: User is on add beneficiary page
Expected Result: Validation errors are shown and no record is created

Description: User activates a new card.
Preconditions: Card issued and not yet activated
Expected Result: Card is activated and status changes to Active

Description: User temporarily blocks and later unblocks the card.
Expected Result: Card status changes correctly and related transactions are restricted/allowed appropriately

Description: Customer raises a card dispute for unauthorized transaction.
Expected Result: Dispute case is created and status is visible to customer

Description: Customer submits loan application with valid income and personal details.
Preconditions: Customer is eligible for loan application
Expected Result: Application is accepted and reference number generated

Description: Loan application is reviewed by bank.
Expected Result: Approval/rejection is processed based on policy and notification sent

Description: Customer views repayment schedule after loan approval.
Expected Result: EMI schedule and total repayment values are accurate

Description: Transaction exceeds risk threshold or suspicious pattern is detected.
Expected Result: User is prompted for additional verification or transaction is blocked

Description: Different user roles access different modules.
Preconditions: Multiple users with different roles exist
Expected Result: Users only access allowed features and data

Description: Customer downloads monthly statement.
Expected Result: Statement is generated and downloaded successfully

Description: Customer receives notification after payment completion.
Expected Result: Email/SMS notification sent with correct transaction reference

Description: Admin creates or updates customer profile.
Expected Result: Profile is created/updated with valid audit trail

Description: User accesses portal from various devices and screen sizes.
Expected Result: UI remains usable and no critical fields are hidden or clipped

Description: User tests keyboard navigation and labels.
Expected Result: Core flows can be navigated using keyboard and labels are readable
